name: White City Cubing 2018
information: Registration will be closed at midnight on July, 4. There is a limit of 200 competitors for this competition. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * **100 RUB** for Rubik's Cube only; * **200 RUB** for equal or less than 6 events; * **300 RUB** greater than 6 events. If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:ruslan.chaika@mail.ru) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/wcc2018) for more details.
